raw_output:
Giver: Hi, I'm starting at the cross. Can you see your start too?
Follower: Yeah, I see the cross at the bottom left.
Giver: Okay, go up a little, past the wagon wheel. Keep it to the left of that wheel.
Follower: Okay, I'm heading up. There's a mine on my left. Are you past the wheel?
Giver: Yes, I'm past it. Now turn right, towards the open space. Go about halfway there.
Follower: Okay, turning right. I see a diamond mine on my left. Are you going left of the mine?
Giver: Yes, keep the mine on your left. Now go down towards the rocks.
Follower: Okay, heading down. I see rocks at the bottom.
Giver: Stop there. I need you to go back up, past the rocks, towards the white water.
Follower: Wait, I see rapids instead of white water. Is that the same place?
Giver: Yeah, that's it. Go up to the rapids. Then turn right, towards the outlaws' hideout.
Follower: Okay, turning right. I see the outlaws' hideout. Are you going left of it?
Giver: Yes, keep the hideout on your left. Now go down a bit, then turn left towards the stone slabs.
Follower: Okay, heading left. I see the stone slabs.
Giver: Go past the slabs. Now turn right, towards the stone creek.
Follower: Okay, turning right. I see the stone creek.
Giver: Keep the creek on your right. Go up, past the swamp.
Follower: Wait, I don't see a swamp on my map. Is there one?
Giver: Oh, maybe it's hidden. Just go up straight. Then turn right, towards the noose.
Follower: Okay, turning right. I see the noose.
Giver: Keep the noose on your right. Go up, past the noose. Then turn left, towards the swan pond.
Follower: Okay, turning left. I see a swan pond!
Giver: Yes, keep the swan pond on your left. Now go down, past the saloon bar.
Follower: Okay, I see the saloon bar.
Giver: Keep the bar on your right. Go up to the finish line.
Follower: Okay, heading up. Is that the finish?
Giver: Yes! You made it.
Follower: Great, I've drawn the line all the way to the finish.
Giver: Perfect. Good job.
Follower: Thanks!
